name: level-meter
title: Level Meter
description: A segmented live input-level meter for a recording — Web Audio RMS from a MediaStream, or a level you drive — with warning and clipping zones.

meta.whenToUse: Show that a microphone is being heard while recording or before a call starts.
meta.whenNotToUse: Playback progress or a seek bar (AudioPlayer), or a static measurement (Progress or Meter).
